class_name OperationShell
extends Node3D

## Minimal production greybox renderer/collider for OperationLayout.
## This is deliberately presentation-light: topology first, final art later.

const PALETTE := {
	# Recovered value hierarchy from lab/vs-map-visual: warm readable canyon,
	# bright industrial objective, cyan reserved for EX/resource identity.
	"ground": Color(0.77, 0.64, 0.41),
	"rock": Color(0.66, 0.49, 0.28),
	"core": Color(0.72, 0.77, 0.80),
	"platform": Color(0.30, 0.32, 0.35),
	"ring": Color(0.42, 0.43, 0.41),
	"wall_A": Color(0.56, 0.36, 0.18),
	"wall_B": Color(0.20, 0.55, 0.29),
	"wall_C": Color(0.55, 0.20, 0.34),
	"bulkhead": Color(0.55, 0.20, 0.16),
	"perch": Color(0.54, 0.42, 0.26),
	"supply": Color(1.0, 0.62, 0.10),
	"extract": Color(0.82, 0.62, 0.12),
	"ex": Color(0.10, 0.95, 1.00),
}

var _bulkhead_mesh: MeshInstance3D = null
var _bulkhead_body: StaticBody3D = null
var _greedy_marks: Array[Node3D] = []
var _hazard_label: Label3D = null
var _breach_label: Label3D = null
var _breach_alarm: OmniLight3D = null


func _ready() -> void:
	_build()


func _build() -> void:
	_setup_environment()
	for blocker in OperationLayout.blockers():
		_add_blocker(blocker)
	for marker in OperationLayout.markers():
		_add_marker(marker)
	_add_semantic_labels()
	_add_readability_cues()
	_add_greedy_marks()
	_add_hazard_label()
	set_greedy(false)
	set_hazard("")


func _setup_environment() -> void:
	# Presentation-only recovery from the accepted Cinder Canyon lab.
	# Lighting does not participate in nav, combat or network authority.
	var world_env := WorldEnvironment.new()
	world_env.name = "CinderEnvironment"
	var env := Environment.new()
	env.background_mode = Environment.BG_SKY
	var sky := Sky.new()
	var sky_mat := ProceduralSkyMaterial.new()
	sky_mat.sky_top_color = Color(0.38, 0.46, 0.55)
	sky_mat.sky_horizon_color = Color(0.71, 0.73, 0.74)
	sky_mat.ground_horizon_color = Color(0.55, 0.54, 0.51)
	sky.sky_material = sky_mat
	env.sky = sky
	env.ambient_light_source = Environment.AMBIENT_SOURCE_SKY
	env.tonemap_mode = Environment.TONE_MAPPER_FILMIC
	world_env.environment = env
	add_child(world_env)


func set_lane_c_open(open: bool) -> void:
	if _bulkhead_mesh != null:
		_bulkhead_mesh.visible = not open
	if _bulkhead_body != null:
		var shape := _bulkhead_body.get_node_or_null("Collision")
		if shape is CollisionShape3D:
			shape.disabled = open
	if _breach_label != null:
		_breach_label.text = "LANE C // OPEN" if open else "BREACH // SEALED"
		_breach_label.modulate = Color(0.25, 0.95, 0.55) if open else Color(1.0, 0.18, 0.12)
	if _breach_alarm != null:
		_breach_alarm.light_color = Color(0.25, 0.95, 0.55) if open else Color(1.0, 0.12, 0.08)
		_breach_alarm.light_energy = 0.7 if open else 2.0


func set_greedy(on: bool) -> void:
	for mark in _greedy_marks:
		mark.visible = on


func set_hazard(id: String) -> void:
	if _hazard_label == null:
		return
	_hazard_label.visible = id != ""
	_hazard_label.text = id.replace("_", " ")
	_hazard_label.modulate = Color(1.0, 0.35, 0.18) if id == "EMI_SURGE" \
		else Color(0.92, 0.72, 0.28)


func _add_readability_cues() -> void:
	var p := OperationLayout.pois()
	# Placeholder lane language from the accepted map-visual lab. These are
	# non-colliding presentation marks; topology and OperationNav stay untouched.
	_add_lane_path([
		p.spawn_A, p.laneA_mouth, p.laneA_turn, p.laneA_lip, p.core
	], Color(0.88, 0.44, 0.12))
	_add_lane_path([
		p.spawn_B, p.laneB_mouth, p.laneB_pinch, p.laneB_lip, p.core
	], Color(0.20, 0.90, 0.35))
	_add_lane_path([
		p.spawn_C, p.laneC_gate, p.laneC_exit, p.core
	], Color(0.95, 0.15, 0.45))

	_add_beacon(p.laneA_mouth, Color(0.88, 0.44, 0.12))
	_add_beacon(p.laneB_mouth, Color(0.20, 0.90, 0.35))
	_add_beacon(p.laneC_gate, Color(0.95, 0.15, 0.45))

	_breach_label = Label3D.new()
	_breach_label.name = "BreachState"
	_breach_label.text = "BREACH // SEALED"
	_breach_label.position = p.laneC_gate + Vector3(0, 4.6, 0)
	_breach_label.modulate = Color(1.0, 0.18, 0.12)
	_breach_label.font_size = 104
	_breach_label.pixel_size = 0.009
	_breach_label.outline_size = 12
	_breach_label.billboard = BaseMaterial3D.BILLBOARD_ENABLED
	add_child(_breach_label)

	_breach_alarm = OmniLight3D.new()
	_breach_alarm.name = "BreachAlarm"
	_breach_alarm.position = p.laneC_gate + Vector3(0, 3.2, 0)
	_breach_alarm.light_color = Color(1.0, 0.12, 0.08)
	_breach_alarm.light_energy = 2.0
	_breach_alarm.omni_range = 7.0
	add_child(_breach_alarm)


func _add_lane_path(points: Array, color: Color) -> void:
	for i in range(points.size() - 1):
		_add_lane_strip(points[i], points[i + 1], color)


func _add_lane_strip(from: Vector3, to: Vector3, color: Color) -> void:
	var flat := to - from
	flat.y = 0.0
	var length := flat.length()
	if length <= 0.1:
		return
	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
	mi.name = "LaneStripe"
	var plane := PlaneMesh.new()
	plane.size = Vector2(1.15, length)
	mi.mesh = plane
	mi.position = (from + to) * 0.5 + Vector3(0, 0.035, 0)
	mi.rotation.y = atan2(flat.x, flat.z)
	var mat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	mat.albedo_color = Color(color, 0.48)
	mat.roughness = 0.85
	mat.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	mi.material_override = mat
	add_child(mi)


func _add_beacon(pos: Vector3, color: Color) -> void:
	var pole := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var cylinder := CylinderMesh.new()
	cylinder.top_radius = 0.12
	cylinder.bottom_radius = 0.12
	cylinder.height = 2.6
	cylinder.radial_segments = 8
	pole.mesh = cylinder
	pole.position = pos + Vector3(0, 1.3, 0)
	pole.material_override = _material("platform")
	add_child(pole)

	var head := MeshInstance3D.new()
	var sphere := SphereMesh.new()
	sphere.radius = 0.20
	sphere.height = 0.40
	head.mesh = sphere
	head.position = pos + Vector3(0, 2.75, 0)
	var mat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	mat.albedo_color = color
	mat.emission_enabled = true
	mat.emission = color
	mat.emission_energy_multiplier = 2.0
	head.material_override = mat
	add_child(head)


func _add_hazard_label() -> void:
	_hazard_label = Label3D.new()
	_hazard_label.position = OperationLayout.pois().core + Vector3(0, 9, 0)
	_hazard_label.font_size = 112
	_hazard_label.pixel_size = 0.011
	_hazard_label.outline_size = 12
	_hazard_label.billboard = BaseMaterial3D.BILLBOARD_ENABLED
	add_child(_hazard_label)


func _material(kind: String, emission: bool = false) -> StandardMaterial3D:
	var mat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	mat.albedo_color = PALETTE.get(kind, Color(0.45, 0.45, 0.45))
	mat.roughness = 0.9
	if emission:
		mat.emission_enabled = true
		mat.emission = mat.albedo_color
		mat.emission_energy_multiplier = 2.0
	return mat


func _add_blocker(blocker: Dictionary) -> void:
	var mesh_instance := MeshInstance3D.new()
	mesh_instance.name = "%s_Visual" % String(blocker.name)
	var mesh := BoxMesh.new()
	mesh.size = blocker.size
	mesh_instance.mesh = mesh
	mesh_instance.position = blocker.pos
	mesh_instance.material_override = _material(String(blocker.kind), blocker.kind == "ex")
	add_child(mesh_instance)

	var body := StaticBody3D.new()
	body.name = "%s_Body" % String(blocker.name)
	body.position = blocker.pos
	body.collision_layer = 1
	var collision := CollisionShape3D.new()
	collision.name = "Collision"
	var shape := BoxShape3D.new()
	shape.size = blocker.size
	collision.shape = shape
	body.add_child(collision)
	add_child(body)

	if blocker.name == "bulkhead":
		_bulkhead_mesh = mesh_instance
		_bulkhead_body = body


func _add_marker(marker: Dictionary) -> void:
	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
	mi.name = "%s_Marker" % String(marker.name)
	var plane := PlaneMesh.new()
	plane.size = marker.size
	mi.mesh = plane
	mi.position = marker.pos + Vector3(0, 0.025, 0)
	var kind := String(marker.kind)
	var color_kind := "extract"
	if kind == "supply":
		color_kind = "supply"
	elif kind == "mech":
		color_kind = "ex"
	elif kind == "socket":
		color_kind = "core"
	elif kind.begins_with("spawn_"):
		color_kind = "bulkhead"
	var mat := _material(color_kind, kind in ["supply", "mech"])
	mat.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
	mat.albedo_color.a = 0.6
	mi.material_override = mat
	add_child(mi)


func _add_semantic_labels() -> void:
	var p := OperationLayout.pois()
	var labels := [
		["CORE / EX", p.core + Vector3(0, 6, 0), Color(0.9, 0.9, 0.9)],
		["LANE A", p.laneA_mouth + Vector3(0, 3, 0), Color(0.95, 0.45, 0.12)],
		["LANE B", p.laneB_mouth + Vector3(0, 3, 0), Color(0.20, 0.90, 0.35)],
		["LANE C / BREACH", p.laneC_exit + Vector3(0, 3, 0), Color(0.95, 0.15, 0.45)],
		["SUPPLY", p.supply_point + Vector3(0, 2.5, 0), Color(1.0, 0.62, 0.10)],
		["EXTRACT", p.extraction_pad + Vector3(0, 2.5, 0), Color(1.0, 0.82, 0.10)],
		["MECH", p.mech_drop + Vector3(0, 2.5, 0), Color(0.25, 0.85, 1.0)],
	]
	for spec in labels:
		var label := Label3D.new()
		label.text = spec[0]
		label.position = spec[1]
		label.modulate = spec[2]
		label.font_size = 96
		label.pixel_size = 0.01
		label.outline_size = 10
		label.billboard = BaseMaterial3D.BILLBOARD_ENABLED
		add_child(label)


func _add_greedy_marks() -> void:
	for pos in [Vector3(0, 0.04, -14), Vector3(-9, 0.04, 5), Vector3(9, 0.04, 5), Vector3(15, 0.04, 0)]:
		var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
		var plane := PlaneMesh.new()
		plane.size = Vector2(8, 1.0)
		mi.mesh = plane
		mi.position = pos
		mi.material_override = _material("ex", true)
		add_child(mi)
		_greedy_marks.append(mi)

extends Node3D
class_name CoreObject
## Reliable objective HP + presentation. Networking semantics remain VS2-T5;
## only the old generic cube proxy is replaced by a distinct EX generator.

var core_hp := 1000


func _ready() -> void:
	_build_generator_visual()

	var sync := StateSynchronizer.new()
	sync.name = "StateSync"
	sync.root = self
	sync.properties = [":core_hp"]
	add_child(sync)


func _build_generator_visual() -> void:
	var dark := Color(0.10, 0.13, 0.15)
	var steel := Color(0.32, 0.38, 0.42)
	var ex := Color(0.08, 0.78, 0.90)

	var base := CylinderMesh.new()
	base.top_radius = 1.75
	base.bottom_radius = 1.95
	base.height = 0.55
	base.radial_segments = 10
	_add_mesh("CoreBase", base, Vector3(0, 0.28, 0), dark)

	var body := CylinderMesh.new()
	body.top_radius = 0.82
	body.bottom_radius = 1.08
	body.height = 2.45
	body.radial_segments = 8
	_add_mesh("CoreBody", body, Vector3(0, 1.48, 0), steel)

	for p in [
		Vector3(1.25, 1.0, 0),
		Vector3(-1.25, 1.0, 0),
		Vector3(0, 1.0, 1.25),
		Vector3(0, 1.0, -1.25),
	]:
		var strut := BoxMesh.new()
		strut.size = Vector3(0.34, 1.45, 0.34)
		_add_mesh("CoreStrut", strut, p, dark)

	var chamber := SphereMesh.new()
	chamber.radius = 0.58
	chamber.height = 1.16
	_add_mesh("EXChamber", chamber, Vector3(0, 1.75, 0), ex, true)

	var crown := CylinderMesh.new()
	crown.top_radius = 1.15
	crown.bottom_radius = 1.15
	crown.height = 0.22
	crown.radial_segments = 10
	_add_mesh("CoreCrown", crown, Vector3(0, 2.72, 0), ex, true)

	var light := OmniLight3D.new()
	light.name = "EXGlow"
	light.light_color = ex
	light.light_energy = 1.5
	light.omni_range = 5.5
	light.position = Vector3(0, 1.8, 0)
	add_child(light)


func _add_mesh(name_v: String, mesh_v: Mesh, pos: Vector3, color: Color,
		emissive: bool = false) -> void:
	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
	mi.name = name_v
	mi.mesh = mesh_v
	mi.position = pos
	var mat := StandardMaterial3D.new()
	mat.albedo_color = color
	mat.roughness = 0.72
	if emissive:
		mat.emission_enabled = true
		mat.emission = color
		mat.emission_energy_multiplier = 2.4
	mi.material_override = mat
	add_child(mi)


func apply_core_damage(dmg: int) -> void:
	if multiplayer.is_server():
		core_hp = maxi(0, core_hp - dmg)

extends Node
class_name PilotInput
## Network input holder for one production pilot.
## Owned by the player peer; the PlayerAvatar remains host-authoritative.
## Edge-triggered actions are sequence numbers so rollback resimulation cannot
## manufacture extra gameplay events.

var move := Vector2.ZERO
var look_yaw := 0.0
var look_pitch := 0.0
var fire_seq := 0
var jump_seq := 0
var aiming := false

class_name OperationHud
extends CanvasLayer
## Player-facing operation HUD. Consumes only OperationPresentationAdapter;
## gameplay authority and MissionKernel internals stay outside this layer.

const AMBER := Color(1.0, 0.69, 0.0)
const AMBER_DIM := Color(0.48, 0.31, 0.0)
const OK := Color(0.24, 0.86, 0.55)
const ALERT := Color(1.0, 0.31, 0.18)
const INFO := Color(0.22, 0.78, 0.85)
const BG := Color(0.025, 0.02, 0.015, 0.86)

var adapter: OperationPresentationAdapter = null
var _root: Control
var _player: Label
var _wave: Label
var _objective: Label
var _threat: Label
var _systems: Label
var _toast: Label
var _minimap: OperationMinimap
var _interwave: PanelContainer
var _interwave_text: Label
var _result: PanelContainer
var _result_text: Label
var _toast_until_ms := 0


func setup(p_adapter: OperationPresentationAdapter) -> void:
	adapter = p_adapter
	if adapter != null:
		if not adapter.snapshot_changed.is_connected(_on_snapshot):
			adapter.snapshot_changed.connect(_on_snapshot)
		if not adapter.gameplay_event.is_connected(_on_gameplay_event):
			adapter.gameplay_event.connect(_on_gameplay_event)
		_on_snapshot(adapter.snapshot())


func _ready() -> void:
	_root = Control.new()
	_root.name = "OperationHudRoot"
	_root.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	_root.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	add_child(_root)

	_player = _panel_label("PilotPanel", 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0,
		Vector4(20, 20, 300, 112), 20, AMBER)
	_wave = _panel_label("WavePanel", 0.5, 0.0, 0.5, 0.0,
		Vector4(-190, 20, 190, 92), 22, AMBER)
	_objective = _panel_label("ObjectivePanel", 1.0, 0.0, 1.0, 0.0,
		Vector4(-360, 20, -20, 138), 20, INFO)
	_threat = _panel_label("ThreatPanel", 0.5, 0.0, 0.5, 0.0,
		Vector4(-280, 104, 280, 162), 18, ALERT)
	_systems = _panel_label("SystemsPanel", 1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0,
		Vector4(-390, -164, -20, -20), 18, AMBER)

	_minimap = OperationMinimap.new()
	_minimap.name = "OperationMinimap"
	_minimap.anchor_left = 0.0
	_minimap.anchor_top = 1.0
	_minimap.anchor_right = 0.0
	_minimap.anchor_bottom = 1.0
	_minimap.offset_left = 20
	_minimap.offset_top = -250
	_minimap.offset_right = 250
	_minimap.offset_bottom = -20
	_root.add_child(_minimap)

	_toast = Label.new()
	_toast.name = "GameplayToast"
	_toast.anchor_left = 0.5
	_toast.anchor_right = 0.5
	_toast.offset_left = -420
	_toast.offset_right = 420
	_toast.offset_top = 176
	_toast.offset_bottom = 218
	_toast.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	_toast.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 24)
	_toast.add_theme_color_override("font_color", AMBER)
	_toast.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	_root.add_child(_toast)

	_interwave = _center_overlay("InterWave", Vector2(620, 250), AMBER)
	_interwave_text = _overlay_label(_interwave, 22)
	_result = _center_overlay("Result", Vector2(620, 280), INFO)
	_result_text = _overlay_label(_result, 22)
	_interwave.visible = false
	_result.visible = false


func _panel_label(name_v: String, al: float, at: float, ar: float, ab: float,
		offsets: Vector4, font_size: int, accent: Color) -> Label:
	var panel := PanelContainer.new()
	panel.name = name_v
	panel.anchor_left = al
	panel.anchor_top = at
	panel.anchor_right = ar
	panel.anchor_bottom = ab
	panel.offset_left = offsets.x
	panel.offset_top = offsets.y
	panel.offset_right = offsets.z
	panel.offset_bottom = offsets.w
	panel.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = BG
	style.border_color = Color(accent, 0.58)
	style.set_border_width_all(1)
	style.content_margin_left = 12
	style.content_margin_right = 12
	style.content_margin_top = 8
	style.content_margin_bottom = 8
	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)
	_root.add_child(panel)
	var label := Label.new()
	label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", font_size)
	label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", accent)
	label.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	label.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	panel.add_child(label)
	return label


func _center_overlay(name_v: String, size_v: Vector2, accent: Color) -> PanelContainer:
	var panel := PanelContainer.new()
	panel.name = name_v
	panel.anchor_left = 0.5
	panel.anchor_top = 0.5
	panel.anchor_right = 0.5
	panel.anchor_bottom = 0.5
	panel.offset_left = -size_v.x * 0.5
	panel.offset_top = -size_v.y * 0.5
	panel.offset_right = size_v.x * 0.5
	panel.offset_bottom = size_v.y * 0.5
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = Color(0.018, 0.014, 0.01, 0.95)
	style.border_color = accent
	style.set_border_width_all(2)
	style.content_margin_left = 24
	style.content_margin_right = 24
	style.content_margin_top = 20
	style.content_margin_bottom = 20
	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", style)
	_root.add_child(panel)
	return panel


func _overlay_label(panel: PanelContainer, font_size: int) -> Label:
	var label := Label.new()
	label.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", font_size)
	label.add_theme_color_override("font_color", AMBER)
	label.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	label.vertical_alignment = VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	label.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
	label.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	panel.add_child(label)
	return label


func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	if _toast != null and Time.get_ticks_msec() > _toast_until_ms:
		_toast.text = ""


func _on_snapshot(s: Dictionary) -> void:
	if _player == null:
		return
	_minimap.update_state(s)

	var hp_pct := int(round(float(s.get("player_hp", 1.0)) * 100.0))
	var pstate := str(s.get("player_state", "on_foot")).to_upper()
	_player.text = "PILOT // %s\nHP %03d%%  // LMB FIRE  RMB AIM  SPACE JUMP" % [pstate, hp_pct]

	var wave := int(s.get("wave", 0))
	var wave_total := int(s.get("waves_total", 3))
	var phase := str(s.get("phase", "deploy")).to_upper()
	_wave.text = "WAVE %d/%d  //  %s" % [wave, wave_total, phase]

	var core_pct := int(round(float(s.get("core_hp", 0.0)) * 100.0))
	var ex := int(s.get("ex_current", 0))
	var quota := int(s.get("quota", 0))
	var risk := str(s.get("risk_state", "safe")).to_upper()
	_objective.text = "CORE %03d%%\nEX %d / %d\nRISK // %s" % [core_pct, ex, quota, risk]
	_objective.add_theme_color_override("font_color", ALERT if risk == "GREEDY" else INFO)

	var dens: Dictionary = s.get("threat_lanes", {})
	var next_lane := str(s.get("next_threat_lane", ""))
	var priority := str(s.get("priority_threat_lane", ""))
	_threat.text = "THREAT  A %s   B %s   C %s   // NEXT %s  PRIORITY %s" % [
		_meter(float(dens.get("A", 0.0))),
		_meter(float(dens.get("B", 0.0))),
		_meter(float(dens.get("C", 0.0))),
		next_lane if next_lane != "" else "--",
		priority if priority != "" else "--"]

	var mech_state := str(s.get("mech_state", "none")).to_upper()
	var mech_hp := int(round(float(s.get("mech_integrity", 1.0)) * 100.0))
	var supply := int(round(float(s.get("supply_state", 0.0)) * 100.0))
	var extract := "READY" if bool(s.get("extract_available", false)) else "LOCKED"
	var turret_summary := _turret_summary(s.get("turret_ammo_state", []))
	_systems.text = "MECH %s %03d%%\nSUPPLY %03d%%  // %s\nEXTRACT %s  // E AT PAD\nF SUPPLY  R RELOCATE  M MECH" % [
		mech_state, mech_hp, supply, turret_summary, extract]

	_interwave.visible = phase == "INTERWAVE"
	if _interwave.visible:
		_interwave_text.text = (
			"INTER-WAVE // CONTRACT CONTROL\n\n"+
			"NEXT THREAT: %s    CURRENT RISK: %s\n"+
			"ENTER — CONTINUE    G — SAFE/GREEDY    E — EXTRACT AT PAD\n\n"+
			"Quota reached: %s") % [
				next_lane if next_lane != "" else "PENDING",
				risk,
				"YES" if bool(s.get("extract_available", false)) else "NO"]

	var result_v = s.get("result", {})
	_result.visible = phase == "ENDED" or (result_v is Dictionary and not result_v.is_empty())
	if _result.visible:
		var outcome := "OPERATION COMPLETE"
		if result_v is Dictionary:
			outcome = str(result_v.get("outcome", result_v.get("result", outcome))).to_upper()
		_result_text.text = (
			"%s\n\nCORE %03d%%   EX %d / %d\n"+
			"SESSION COMPLETE // TELEMETRY SAVED TO user://logs") % [
			outcome, core_pct, ex, quota]


func _meter(v: float) -> String:
	var n := int(round(clampf(v, 0.0, 1.0) * 4.0))
	return "[" + "■".repeat(n) + "·".repeat(4 - n) + "]"


func _turret_summary(states_v) -> String:
	if not states_v is Array or states_v.is_empty():
		return "DEFENSE --"
	var parts: Array[String] = []
	for t in states_v:
		if not t is Dictionary:
			continue
		var ammo := int(t.get("ammo", 0))
		var cap := maxi(1, int(t.get("ammo_max", 1)))
		parts.append("%s %d%%" % [str(t.get("kind", "?")), int(round(100.0 * ammo / cap))])
	return "  ".join(parts) if not parts.is_empty() else "DEFENSE --"


func _on_gameplay_event(ename: StringName, payload: Dictionary) -> void:
	var msg := ""
	var color := AMBER
	match String(ename):
		"wave_started":
			msg = "WAVE COMMITTED // LANES %s" % str(payload.get("lanes", []))
		"core_damaged":
			msg = "CORE IMPACT // DEFENSE LIABILITY"
			color = ALERT
		"risk_changed":
			msg = "RISK PROFILE // %s" % str(payload.get("state", "safe")).to_upper()
		"quota_met":
			msg = "CONTRACT MINIMUM MET // EXTRACT OR CONTINUE"
			color = OK
		"harasser_lock":
			msg = "HARASSER LOCK // %s" % str(payload.get("target", "INFRA"))
			color = ALERT
		"harasser_strike":
			msg = "HARASSER STRIKE // %s" % str(payload.get("target", "INFRA"))
			color = ALERT
		"pilot_hit":
			msg = "PILOT HIT // %s" % str(payload.get("source_role", "ENEMY"))
			color = ALERT
		"pilot_down":
			msg = "PILOT DOWN"
			color = ALERT
		"hazard_started":
			msg = str(payload.get("hazard_id", "HAZARD")).replace("_", " ")
			color = ALERT
		"extraction_denied":
			msg = "EXTRACTION DENIED // REACH PAD"
			color = ALERT
		"mission_success":
			msg = "CONTRACT RESOLVED // SUCCESS"
			color = OK
		"mission_failed":
			msg = "CONTRACT RESOLVED // FAILURE"
			color = ALERT
		_:
			return
	_toast.text = msg
	_toast.add_theme_color_override("font_color", color)
	_toast_until_ms = Time.get_ticks_msec() + 3200

	"t","player_state","player_hp","core_hp","ex_current","quota","risk_state",

## End-to-end proof of the benchmark pipe: runs a fixed frame count, samples
## PERF, exits 0. Real benchmark scenes arrive with labs profiling work.

const DURATION_FRAMES := 300
const SAMPLE_EVERY := 60

var _frames := 0


func _ready() -> void:
	Log.runtime("benchmark '%s' started" % Session.benchmark_name)


func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	_frames += 1
	if _frames % SAMPLE_EVERY == 0:
		Log.perf("frame=%d fps=%d" % [_frames, Engine.get_frames_per_second()])
	if _frames >= DURATION_FRAMES:
		Log.perf("benchmark '%s' finished after %d frames" % [Session.benchmark_name, _frames])
		Log.shutdown()
		get_tree().quit(0)

## Process entry point (project main scene). Parses CLI user args (everything
## after "--"), routes the launch mode, owns process exit codes:
##   0 success | 1 runtime failure | 2 usage/config error
## Two-instance dev loop:
##   godot --path game -- --host
##   godot --path game -- --connect=127.0.0.1

const WORLD := "res://scenes/main.tscn"
## HOST/CLIENT mount the net world (wave step 2): avatars + crowd + core over
## the transport seam. Solo NORMAL keeps the bare greybox world.
const NET_WORLD := "res://net/net_session.tscn"

const BENCHMARKS := {
	"noop": "res://scenes/benchmark_noop.tscn",
}

const USAGE_TEMPL := """usage: godot --path game [--headless] -- [options]
  --host                 act as authoritative server
  --connect=HOST[:PORT]  join a host
  --port=N               port (default 7777)
  --seed=N               deterministic seed (default 1)
  --test                 run headless smoke suite
  --benchmark=NAME       run named benchmark (%s)
  --operation            authored playable operation (host/client)
  --crowd-sim            real CrowdSim stress/bench backend
  --crowd-count=N        crowd capacity/benchmark target
  --log-file             force file sink under user://logs/
  --log-cats=A,B,C       restrict categories (RUNTIME NETWORK MISSION CROWD COMBAT PERF)
with no options (headful): local authoritative playable operation"""


func _ready() -> void:
	var user_args := OS.get_cmdline_user_args()
	var err: Error = Session.apply(user_args)
	if err != OK:
		printerr(USAGE_TEMPL % ", ".join(BENCHMARKS.keys()))
		get_tree().quit(2)
		return

	# F5 / no-args should exercise the actual vertical slice, not the old bare
	# skeleton. Keep headless no-args NORMAL for tooling that expects a bounded
	# process unless it explicitly selects --host/--operation.
	if user_args.is_empty() and DisplayServer.get_name() != "headless":
		Session.enable_local_operation()

	# Freshness (vs1-T1): measured sessions regenerate the version stamp so
	# their logs never carry a stale sha; other boots warn when none exists.
	var stamp_status := ""
	if Session.mode == Session.Mode.TEST or Session.mode == Session.Mode.BENCHMARK:
		stamp_status = Version.regenerate()
	elif not FileAccess.file_exists("res://VERSION.json"):
		printerr("Version: VERSION.json missing — build id reads '+dev'. " +
			"Generate: godot --headless --path game -s res://tools/make_version.gd")

	Log.setup()
	Log.runtime("boot mode=%s" % String(Session.Mode.keys()[Session.mode]).to_lower())
	if stamp_status != "":
		Log.runtime("version stamp %s" % stamp_status)

	match Session.mode:
		Session.Mode.TEST:
			var code: int = SmokeLib.run_all()
			Log.shutdown()
			get_tree().quit(code)
		Session.Mode.BENCHMARK:
			if not BENCHMARKS.has(Session.benchmark_name):
				printerr("Unknown benchmark '%s'. Known: %s" % [
					Session.benchmark_name, ", ".join(BENCHMARKS.keys()),
				])
				get_tree().quit(2)
				return
			Log.runtime("benchmark '%s' starting" % Session.benchmark_name)
			get_tree().change_scene_to_file.call_deferred(BENCHMARKS[Session.benchmark_name])
		Session.Mode.HOST:
			if Net.start(Session.Mode.HOST) != OK:
				get_tree().quit(1)
				return
			_enter_world()
		Session.Mode.CLIENT:
			if Net.start(Session.Mode.CLIENT) != OK:
				get_tree().quit(1)
				return
			_enter_world()
		_:
			_enter_world()


func _enter_world() -> void:
	# Overlay hangs off the root so it survives change_scene_to_file().
	if OS.is_debug_build():
		get_tree().root.add_child.call_deferred(
			load("res://scenes/debug_overlay.tscn").instantiate())
	var world := WORLD
	if Session.mode == Session.Mode.HOST or Session.mode == Session.Mode.CLIENT:
		world = NET_WORLD
	get_tree().change_scene_to_file.call_deferred(world)


func _notification(what: int) -> void:
	if what == NOTIFICATION_WM_CLOSE_REQUEST:
		Log.shutdown()
